physicalNotes: Radius 1.8 +/- 0.2 Jupiter radii and temperature 1800 +/- 20 K: the BT-SETTL13 column of Palma-Bifani et al. (2023, A&A 670, A90), Table 4, fitted to the full spectral energy distribution: 128,685.6 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. A model radius: the planet is unresolved. Their Exo-REM fit gives 1700 +/- 50 K; evolutionary models give 1.50 to 1.57 Jupiter radii (their Table 3). GM from the mass 10 +/- 1 Jupiter masses they report, times Jupiter's GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
